name: dreamy-motion-editorial
title_zh: 把随手拍蒸成一张带呼吸感的高级氛围海报
tagline_zh: 你手机里那张过曝的废片、虚焦的街角、逆光的背影——它不删，它把主体捞出来，留白、压暗、晕开，变成 Pinteres。
tagline_en: That blurry, blown-out, forgettable shot? It rescues the subject, clears the noise, and reissues it as a dreamy.
desc_en: Extract the semantic hero from any casual photo and rebuild it as a premium hazy dreamlike motion-editorial image with large negative space, simplified context, selective preservation, and restrained poster hierarchy. Use when the user provides or references a photo and asks for 高级感、朦胧感、梦幻感、电影感、慢门拖影、柔焦、胶片感、诗意海报、Pinterest 同类氛围、图生图提示词、AI 生图提示词、照片风格改造、帖子视觉、封面图、艺术摄影、青春残影、玻璃倒影、花卉虚焦、逆光晕染, or wants a reu
why_zh: 不是套滤镜。它先语义拆解主体与杂物，再按“大留白、弱环境、保细节、压层级”四步重建——像给照片做了次策。
why_en: No filter stack. It semantically separates subject from clutter, then rebuilds via negative space, context stripping, selective.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不吃视频帧序列；输出是图生图提示词+构图方案，不直接出成品图。人像多、场景杂的纪实照会因主体不清而效果打。
limit_en: Single stills only, no video frames. Outputs prompt + layout plan, not final images. Busy scenes with multiple subjects dilute the effect.
